item.title: Introduction to Drawing Portraits From Photos (3 Session Class) — Wed Dec 2, 6:00 PM — Sebastopol Center for the Arts
item.description: Introduction to Drawing Portraits from Photos November 4th, 11th, and 18th 6:00-9:00pm $150.00 + $15.00 Materials Fee = $165.00 Age Restricted to 18+ About this class: In this three week course, students will learn and practice observational skills and fundamental drawing techniques while learning the basics of drawing portraits from photographs. Drawing human faces requires the same basic drawing skills that one employs for any subject – observing proportion, flattening shapes, and utilizing line or value to convey volume. But the conceptual weight of human faces tends to intimidate artists. When drawing any subject, the hardest skill is simply learning to see, a skill that anyone can be taught, practice, and hone. This course will focus on the practice of looking, and discovering strategies to find objectivity when rendering portraits. Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Workshop: Intro to Letterpress — Sat Dec 5, 10:00 AM — North Bay Letterpress Arts
item.description:
Get hands-on with the art of letterpress in this beginner-friendly workshop. We’ll explore the basics of printing on a press, from setting up a design to inking and pulling your very first prints. Along the way, you’ll learn about the history of letterpress, the different kinds of presses, and the tools and materials that bring this centuries-old craft to life. Each participant will work together to create collaborative prints to take home—while experiencing the unique textures and tactile beauty that only letterpress can offer. No prior experience required—just bring your creativity and a willingness to get inky!
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: Holiday Wreath Making with Fresh Evergreens — Sat Dec 5, 10:30 AM — Gather Sebastopol
item.description:
Get your home holiday-ready at Gather Sebastopol with a hands-on fresh wreath workshop. You’ll work with cedar, redwood, fir, and pine to build a full, festive 14-inch wreath, and you’ll leave with it ready to hang for the season. You’ll: • Learn how different evergreens work together in a wreath • Choose and combine greens for a full, balanced look • Practice basic wreath-making techniques as you build your wreath • Add natural decorations like pinecones and berries • Take home your finished fresh evergreen wreath No wreath-making experience needed. All materials included.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: Petaluma Children's Business Fair — Sat Dec 5, 11:00 AM — The Spring Hill School
item.description:
Come support the next generation of entrepreneurs at the Children’s Business Fair!
Young entrepreneurs from across Sonoma and Marin Counties will bring their business ideas to life, creating products, developing their brands, setting prices, and selling directly to customers at this one-day marketplace.
More than a market, the fair is a hands-on learning experience designed to build creativity, confidence, financial literacy, and real-world business skills. Throughout the day, local business leaders and entrepreneurs will visit student booths, offering encouragement, practical advice, and feedback to help kids think and grow like business owners.
Come shop, discover unique kid-created products, and support the next generation of local entrepreneurs!
Interested in launching your own business? Children from throughout Sonoma and Marin Counties are invited to participate.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Garage Jam — Mon Dec 7, 6:00 PM — Out West Garage
item.description:
The Garage Jam is an open, friendly bluegrass circle that meets the first and third Monday of every month, from 6 to 8 pm. All kinds of pickers show up, from rank beginners to grizzled veterans, plus folks who just come to listen and socialize. The repertoire is straight-up traditional bluegrass, although the occasional old-time or folk-inflected choice will pop up. The format is the old-fashioned song circle, with each participant getting a turn to call a song and set its key, pace, and feel. An experienced jam leader and bass player are always present to help keep things on track. Everyone is welcome — come on down!
Source: California Bluegrass Association

item.description: Introduction to Drawing Portraits from Photos November 4th, 11th, and 18th 6:00-9:00pm $150.00 + $15.00 Materials Fee = $165.00 Age Restricted to 18+ About this class: In this three week course, students will learn and practice observational skills and fundamental drawing techniques while learning the basics of drawing portraits from photographs. Drawing human faces requires the same basic drawing skills that one employs for any subject – observing proportion, flattening shapes, and utilizing line or value to convey volume. But the conceptual weight of human faces tends to intimidate artists. When drawing any subject, the hardest skill is simply learning to see, a skill that anyone can be taught, practice, and hone. This course will focus on the practice of looking, and discovering strategies to find objectivity when rendering portraits. item.title: Muunjuun & Sakoyana — Fri Dec 11, 8:30 PM — The Forestville Club
item.description:
A cosmic funk dance party in West County: Sakoyana, Muunjuun’s first full-band show. Plus DJ Bankshot.
Come ready to move.
Three acts, one long night of groove at The Forestville Club, for fans of Khruangbin, Vulfpeck, Thundercat and Parliament-Funkadelic.
Sakoyana is a Sonoma County band that can turn on a dime from tight, horn-sharp grooves into wide-open jams. Think Snarky Puppy at a backyard party: the kind of set that makes the drummer grin and the whole room bounce.
Muunjuun MOON-june plays music that feels like tripping without the mushrooms. Bootsy Collins called him a “west coast cosmic funktroid.” This is his first show with the full five-piece band, so expect warm, wobbly, sky-high pop-funk that pulls you onto the floor and keeps you there.
DJ Bankshot keeps the floor moving between sets, so there’s no reason to sit down.
Friday, December 11th · 8:30 PM The Forestville Club · Forestville, CA $20 · advance tickets $25 · at the door Limited capacity 21\+
